name: Ocal Browser v9.1.03 (Stable)
body:
OCAL BROWSER - STABLE RELEASE CATALOG
Version: 9.1.03 Stable
Release Date: September 16, 2026

===============================================================================
[GOOGLE CHROME EXTENSION SUPPORT & RUNTIME ENGINE (BETA)]
===============================================================================
* CHROME API RUNTIME SHIMS: Integrated universal compatibility shims for missing Chromium extension APIs (chrome.windows, chrome.storage.sync/session, chrome.action, chrome.tabs, chrome.runtime, chrome.scripting, chrome.contextMenus).
* CHROME WEB STORE COMPATIBILITY: Expanded runtime compatibility allowing popular extensions (e.g. AHA Music, Grammarly, Return YouTube Dislike, Dark Reader) to run natively in Ocal.
* 1-CLICK WEB STORE INJECTOR: Injected smart install buttons and floating installation banners directly into chromewebstore.google.com with active installation state tracking and theme mode/accent color sync.
* DYNAMIC POPUP AUTO-SIZING: Built an intelligent layout-aware sizing engine for extension popups that measures declared CSS rules and DOM bounds in real time, eliminating horizontal gaps and vertical clipping.

===============================================================================
[BETTER UI, SHADOWLESS SHOWROOM & COMPACT TOPBAR]
===============================================================================
* COMPACT EXTENSION CAPSULE: Added a sleek, unobtrusive topbar capsule container that caps visible icons to 2, with an interactive '+N' overflow badge and instant search extension hub dropdown.
* ZERO-JITTER CARDS & SMOOTH HOVER: Fixed hover jitter and double-click requirement on settings cards by removing disruptive hover transformations and enabling in-place state updating.
* SHADOWLESS AESTHETICS: Eliminated heavy drop-shadow artifacts across all popups, menus, and bento cards for clean modern glassmorphic aesthetics.
* CUSTOM CONFIRMATION MODALS: Replaced native Windows confirm dialogs with custom glassmorphic studio modals matching the browser's theme.
* THEME MODE & ACCENT COLOR HARMONY: Real-time synchronization of light/dark modes and custom accent colors across all internal pages, floating banners, and extension popups.

===============================================================================
[SECURITY & BUG FIXES]
===============================================================================
* CONTEXT MENU HARDENING: Removed 'Inspect Element' and 'View Page Source' from right-click context menus on all internal and local pages (ocal://*, file://*, chrome://*).
* BACKGROUND WORKER STORAGE: Hardened chrome.storage polyfills to safely return valid defaults and prevent background service worker crashes.
* LAUNCHER & REGISTRY FIX: Guarded default browser registry entries to prevent development mode binary mismatches and path corruption.

===============================================================================
[PACKAGING & INSTALLER]
===============================================================================
* Standalone x64 installer compiled with Inno Setup 6 (LZMA2/Ultra64 compression) and native file associations.
